nodes.title: STAGE 2 - master OFF also disables this pass

widgets_values:
START HERE
1. Upload your reference in 01 REFERENCE.
2. AUTO RATIO = true: reference aspect, ~1.3 MP; dimensions rounded to 32 px. This is not an exact-pixel copy of reference size.
3. Keep IMAGE TO IMAGE? = false in the LATENT group for the original text-to-image generation. Reference is only used for size and depth.
4. DEPTH MASTER = true, STAGE 2 = false. Stage 1 strength is 0.75; preprocessor resolution is 768.
5. To add control to the second pass, turn STAGE 2 on. Its own strength is below in the Stage 2 row.
6. DEPTH MASTER = false bypasses BOTH depth LoRA/model branches. AUTO RATIO = false restores original manual sizing (and original img2img sizing).
Original samplers, seeds, CFG, steps, sigma schedules, 1.5x latent upscale, prompt, LoRAs and detailers are preserved.
Final pixel count is ~2.25x initial pixel count. No final resize is added.
Depth is not face identity/expression control. FaceDetailer settings were not changed.
New dependencies: comfyui-krea2-controlnet, comfyui_controlnet_aux, ComfyUI-KJNodes; depth-control-lora.safetensors; depth_anything_v2_vitl.pth.
Graph validated; GPU generation has not been tested.
nodes.title: AUTO RATIO + DEPTH - QUICK GUIDE
A = BEFORE COLOR MATCH / B = SAVED RESULT

widgets_values:
COLOR MATCH - OPTIONAL FINAL COLOR CORRECTION
ON/OFF: true = enabled; false = original final image.
Initial strength 0.30, method mkl. Start with 0.15-0.40; 0.0 returns the uncorrected image.
Reference is the image loaded in 01 REFERENCE. Target is the full final image after all detailers.
No extra sampling, no resizing, no extra generative model. Image dimensions stay unchanged.
A = final image before color correction; B = selected result sent to Save FINAL. When OFF both are identical.
Color Match approximates the reference palette and tonal distribution. It does not reconstruct light direction, shadow geometry or facial expression.
Fixed daylight/front-light instructions were removed from the MAIN prompt. The remaining scene description is still manual; adapt it to each reference. Nothing automatically captions the reference.
All sampling, depth, size, img2img and face settings are inherited from this variant.
Requires ComfyUI-KJNodes ColorMatch and its color-matcher Python dependency. No VLM/LLM required.
Final save prefix uses KRAST_ORG/ColorMatch/ to distinguish new outputs. Earlier intermediate saves remain uncorrected.
Workflow graph validated. GPU generation and color correction in your ComfyUI installation have not been run.
